name: Mura
description: Mura is an unusual Hungarian card game for four players. It is a trick-avoidance game where players try not to win tricks, but with a twist: only certain cards (figures) have value, and winning tricks without figures is actually beneficial. The game uses a 32-card Hungarian deck with unique ranking.

history.origins: Mura originated in Hungary, with a 1937 article claiming it was played by rural aristocrats and judicial officials in a patriarchal region of old Hungary. The inventor and exact origins are unknown.
timeline: 1937: First known documentation claims unknown origins
Traditional: Played in Hungarian card-playing circles
Present: Maintained by enthusiasts of Hungarian card games
history.cultural: A game that was historically associated with the Hungarian upper classes. It represents the sophisticated card game tradition of Hungary alongside games like Ulti and Preferansz.
history.evolution: The game has remained relatively stable, preserving its unique trick-avoidance mechanics with the Hungarian card deck.

setup.deck: 32-card Hungarian pack. Suits: Hearts (Piros), Gourds (Tok), Leaves (Zold), Acorns (Makk). Ranking: X, IX, Ace, King, Over (Felso), Under (Also), VIII, VII. Note: X and IX are high, Ace is third highest.
setup.dealing: 8 cards to each player, dealt in packets. Deal and play are counter-clockwise.
setup.equipment: Hungarian deck or modified standard deck, score sheet.

rules.objective: Avoid winning tricks that contain figures (Aces, Kings, Overs, Unders). Winning tricks with only numeral cards (X, IX, VIII, VII) is safe. The player with the fewest figures captured wins.
rules.gameplay: No trumps. Must follow suit if possible. Highest card of led suit wins the trick. The winner of a trick leads to the next.
keyRules: Figures (A, K, Over, Under) are bad to capture
Ace counts as 3 figures if it wins

strategy.basic: Try to win tricks with numeral cards only. Avoid playing high cards that might win tricks containing figures. Get rid of Aces early if you think they will win.
strategy.intermediate: Track which figures have been played. Force opponents to win tricks with figures by playing cards they must overtake. Void yourself in suits where you hold high cards.
strategy.advanced: Card counting is essential with 32 cards. Calculate when to win a trick to reach safety. Understand the timing of when to transition from avoiding tricks to seeking them.
tips: The Ace is dangerous - it counts as 3 figures if it wins
Void yourself in suits where you have high cards
Force opponents to win by playing cards they must beat
Winning tricks with only X, IX, VIII, VII is safe
Watch other players figure counts to adjust your strategy

scoring.description: The player with the most figures captured loses, or the last player in mura loses.
scoring.winCondition: Have the fewest figures, or reach safety before others.
